decisions.decision: Register preference lives in the URL (?mode=plain), never in browser storage
decisions.rationale: leaveWipe.ts clears all storage on pagehide and privacy policy s3 promises nothing persists

decisions.decision: Internal ids stay 'chemist' / 'plain'; UI labels are Expert / Simple
decisions.rationale: User renamed labels mid-run; renaming ids would churn every copy table and test for no functional gain

decisions.decision: Chemist register follows the IUPAC Blue Book (P-7/P-8/P-9) where it has a term; Gold Book or 'InChI-specific' otherwise; Technical Manual is a cross-check only
decisions.rationale: User instruction; Technical Manual judged stale. Text extracts of P7/P8/P9 were used for citation checks

decisions.decision: Glossary tooltips: hover/focus opens, click makes sticky; on the pure hover path terms are reachable only after pinning (tour step 7 says 'pin first'); no 300 ms hover-grace added
decisions.rationale: Leaving the InChI string swaps the card before the pointer arrives; grace would touch 3 leave handlers + 4 enter paths + ~10 tests. fable-advisor concurred

decisions.decision: m-layer text: '0' = parities as written, '1' = inverted
decisions.rationale: Real InChIs: L-alanine /t2-/m0/s1 vs D-alanine /t2-/m1/s1 share /t2-. Previous copy had it reversed

decisions.decision: Pin targets ([data-pin-target]) and glossary terms/tooltips are exempt from the capture-phase click-anywhere release; each target's own onClick toggles by exact match
decisions.rationale: Capture-clear then bubble-re-pin made a click on a pinned item a no-op for layers, sub-tokens and key segments alike

decisions.decision: Superpowers SDD workflow used instead of GSD for this feature
decisions.rationale: User chose it explicitly ('use superpowers-skills, write spec, write-plans, implement using opus, review with fable')
